glossary.definition: (A) "Affiliate" has the same meaning as in division (A)(1) of section 1109.53 of the Revised Code and includes a subsidiary of a bank.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (B) "Bank" or "banking corporation" means an entity that solicits, receives, or accepts money or its equivalent for deposit as a business, whether the deposit is made by check or is evidenced by a certificate of deposit, passbook, note, receipt, ledger card, or otherwise. "Bank" or "banking corporation" includes a state bank or any entity doing business as a bank, savings bank, or savings association under authority granted by the office of the comptroller of the currency or the former office of thrift supervision, the appropriate bank regulatory authority of another state of the United States, or the appropriate bank regulatory authority of another country, but does not include a credit union.

glossary.definition: (C) "Bank holding company" has the same meaning as in the "Bank Holding Company Act of 1956," 70 Stat. 133, 12 U.S.C. 1841, as amended.

glossary.definition: (E) "Branch" means a banking office that is not also the bank's principal place of business consistent with its articles of incorporation or articles of association.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (G) "Code of regulations" includes a constitution adopted by a state bank for similar purposes.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (H) "Control" has the same meaning as in division (H) of section 1109.53 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (I) "Debt securities" means obligations issued by a bank the holders of which, in the event of the insolvency or liquidation of the bank, are subordinated in right of payment to the bank's depositors and general creditors.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (J) "Deposit" has the same meaning as in 12 C.F.R. 204.2, as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (K) "Entity" has the same meaning as in section 1701.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (L) "Federal savings association" means a federal savings and loan association or a federal savings bank doing business under authority granted by the office of the comptroller of the currency or the former office of thrift supervision.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:
As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (N) "Mutual state bank" means a state bank without stock that has governing documents consisting of articles of incorporation and code of regulations adopted by its members and bylaws adopted by its board of directors.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (O) "National bank" means a bank doing business under authority granted by the office of the comptroller of the currency.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (P) "Net income" means all income realized or earned less all expenses realized or accrued.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (Q) "Paid-in capital" means the aggregate par value of all of a stock state bank's outstanding shares of all classes.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (R) "Person" means an individual, sole proprietorship, partnership, joint venture, association, trust, estate, business trust, limited liability company, corporation, or any similar entity or organization.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (S) "Remote service unit" means an automated facility, operated by a customer of a bank, that conducts banking functions, such as receiving deposits, paying withdrawals, or lending money.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (T) "Reorganization" means a consolidation, merger, or transfer of assets and liabilities pursuant to Chapter 1115. or 1116. of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (U) "Savings and loan holding company" has the same meaning as in 12 U.S.C. 1467a.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (V) "Savings association" means a savings and loan association doing business under authority granted by the regulatory authority of another state or a federal savings association. "Savings association" also includes a state bank that elects to operate as a savings and loan association under section 1109.021 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (W) "Savings bank" means a savings bank doing business under authority granted by the regulatory authority of another state.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (X) "Shares" means any equity interest, including a limited partnership interest and any other equity interest in which liability is limited to the amount of the investment. "Shares" does not include a general partnership interest or any other interest involving general liability.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (Y) "State bank" means a bank doing business under authority granted by the superintendent of financial institutions. "State bank" includes a state bank that elects to operate as a savings and loan association under section 1109.021 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (Z) "Stock state bank" means a state bank that has an ownership structure represented by shares of stock.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (AA) "Subsidiary" has the same meaning as in section 1109.53 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (BB) "Surplus" means the total of amounts paid for shares in excess of their respective par values, amounts contributed other than for shares, and amounts transferred from undivided profits, less amounts transferred to stated capital.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (CC) "Trust company" means an entity qualified and licensed under section 1111.06 of the Revised Code to solicit or engage in trust business in this state, or a person that is required by Chapter 1111. of the Revised Code to be an entity qualified and licensed under section 1111.06 of the Revised Code to solicit or engage in trust business in this state.
glossary.scope: As used in Chapters 1101. to 1127. of the Revised Code, unless the context requires otherwise:

glossary.definition: (DD) "Undivided profits" means the cumulative undistributed amount of a bank's net income not otherwise allocated.
